scope.route_owner: S-021 lean_worker under root Program Director acceptance
scope.primary_claim_boundary: The independently hand-coded deterministic route supports the locked all-seven finite-grid validation. Exact-matrix results remain the comprehensive evidence for the second-order classification.
excluded_claims: The finite grid does not establish continuum-wide formulas.
The finite grid does not establish exact equivalence.
The finite grid does not establish event sequencing.

locked_model_and_protocols.event_semantics: Jump generator is rho*(f(R_q(X))-f(X)); no event-sequencing claim is tested by this moment route.

isolation.implementation: experiment-owned independently hand-coded 28-state Ito+jump linear operator derived directly from locked SDE and reset maps
isolation.operator_source_location: experiments-owned implementation created after this plan is locked
production_imports_forbidden: any theory generator, formula module, or registry
prior_result_artifact_reads_forbidden: any prior S-011, S-012, or S-021 result artifact
isolation.allowed_comparison_layer: A separately implemented comparison layer may read T-022 only after the independent operator outputs, residuals, and asymptotic extractions are complete. T-022 must not be imported, parsed, or consulted by the operator builder or propagator.
isolation.required_source_audit: Static import and file-access audit must demonstrate the forbidden dependencies and result artifacts are absent before canonical execution.

operator_specification.construction_rule: Hand-code the Ito drift/diffusion contribution for every basis entry and the map-specific jump image for every basis entry; form A_q=A_Ito+rho*(J_q-I) without calling any pre-existing generator or formula implementation.
operator_specification.reset_pullback_rule: For reset flags (p,v,h), J maps r to (1-p)r, velocity to (1-v)velocity, u to (1-h)u+h*e_x*one, R to (1-p)R, S to (1-v)S, C to (1-p)(1-v)C, Q to (1-p)[(1-h)Q+h*r*e_x^T], W to (1-v)[(1-h)W+h*velocity*e_x^T], and U to (1-h)U+h*e_x*e_x^T*one. The seven flags are P=(1,0,0), V=(0,1,0), Theta=(0,0,1), PV=(1,1,0), PTheta=(1,0,1), VTheta=(0,1,1), PVTheta=(1,1,1).
required_precomparison_checks: all 28 basis names occur exactly once
each map has an explicit hand-coded reset image for every basis entry
all parameters and times parse from exact rational strings
all entries, propagated states, extracted coefficients, and residuals are finite

parameter_grid.rational_parsing: Parse each decimal-free rational string as numerator/denominator integers directly inside the active mpmath precision context; binary floating-point conversion is prohibited.

numerical_schedule.propagation: mpmath matrix exponential action on the experiment-owned operator; no time-step discretization, adaptivity, retries, precision changes, horizon changes, or tolerance tuning.
numerical_schedule.slow_rate_definition: For reset flags (p,v,h), lambda is the minimum positive rate among 1+rho*h, 4+rho*h, 1/M+rho*v, 2/M+rho*v, 1+1/M+rho*int(v or h), 1+rho*int(p or h), 1/M+rho*int(p or v), and additionally rho when p=1. Each OR contributes rho only once because there is one Poisson event.
numerical_schedule.horizon_definition: For every protocol, T=H/lambda and each H in {64,80} is evaluated at each declared precision.
numerical_schedule.position_propagation: For position-containing maps, propagate the default initial state to T and compare the resulting stationary-field estimate across all four precision/horizon cells.
numerical_schedule.transport_algebraic_solve: From A_q alone, solve the nonconstant internal block for stationary one,v,u,S,W,U with one=1. On Y=(v_x,v_y,u_x,u_y), let K=A[Y,Y], y_infinity be the stationary first moments, and y0=(0,0,1,0); compute b as the velocity projection of -K^(-1)(y0-y_infinity). Set the r coefficient to v_bar, the Q coefficient to v_bar*u_bar^T, and the C coefficient to v_bar*v_bar^T. Solve the stable X=(C,Q) block of A*c0=c1 for the constant raw C and Q terms, then center them with b. Set D=sym(C_centered), the R quadratic coefficient to v_bar*v_bar^T, the R linear coefficient to v_bar*b^T+b*v_bar^T+2D, and the T-022 constant gauge to b*b^T.
numerical_schedule.transport_propagation_refinement: For each T=H/lambda cell propagate m_H=expm(A_q*T)m0. Compare its internal block with the algebraic stationary block; extract b_H=r_H-T*v_bar, Q_centered,H=Q_H-r_H*u_H^T, C_centered,H=C_H-r_H*v_H^T, and D_H=sym(C_centered,H). With d=A_q*m_H and d2=A_q*d, extract raw_ru_linear,H=d_Q, raw_rv_linear,H=d_C, raw_rr_quadratic,H=0.5*d2_R, and raw_rr_linear,H=d_R-2*T*raw_rr_quadratic,H. Compare every extracted quantity across precision/horizon cells and with the algebraic solution.
numerical_schedule.transport_reconstruction: Reconstruct the declared long-time polynomial at probe times from the extracted coefficients. Probe t=0 is polynomial extrapolation, not the physical initial state. Never compare the finite-time R_H itself with T-022 because the physical transient retains an unreported bounded O(1) covariance constant.

reference.rule: T-022 is accessed only here, after isolated operator completion, and is evaluated from exact rational inputs at 100 dps.
reference.null_rule: A T-022 field that is explicitly null for a protocol is recorded as inapplicable; every non-null scalar and every Cartesian matrix component is gating.

position_maps.comparison_target: stationary full second-order fields: means, raw tensors, derived scalars, and centered spatial variance
position_maps.stationary_solution: Solve A_q*m=0 with one=1 using an independent augmented linear solve at each precision; compare finite H propagation to this route for tail/convergence and compare the stationary field to T-022 in the separate layer.

transport_maps.comparison_target: extracted asymptotic coefficients and reconstructed transport polynomials for means, raw fields where applicable, centered covariance trace, and D_eff
transport_maps.prohibited_target: finite-time raw-moment agreement is not a formula comparison target
transport_maps.reconstruction_rule: Use the algebraic solve and fixed propagation refinements in numerical_schedule. At every probe t, set r_bar=v_bar*t+b, R=r_bar*r_bar^T+2D*t, C=r_bar*v_bar^T+C_centered, Q=r_bar*u_bar^T+Q_centered, and Cov_r=2D*t; carry the stationary S, W, U and their centered covariances unchanged. Compare the coefficient vector and every applicable reconstructed T-022 field.

invariants_and_residuals.stationary_solve_residual: At dps80 independently solve the constrained stationary system for every position protocol with one=1 and report max_abs(A_q*m); the solve is an internal conditioning check, not a separate scientific route.
invariants_and_residuals.transport_polynomial_residual: At dps80 evaluate max_abs(A_q*c2), max_abs(A_q*c1-2*c2), max_abs(A_q*c0-c1), and max_abs(m'(t)-A_q*m(t)) for the algebraically solved transport polynomial at every probe time.
invariants_and_residuals.finite_horizon_tail_rule: Finite-horizon propagation and extraction are gated by the 1e-12 H=64 versus H=80 comparison, not by relabeling their decaying transient as a linear-solve residual.

classification.cell_error: absolute difference of an isolated-route output and the 100-dps T-022 comparison-layer reference
classification.precision_difference: absolute difference between dps80 and dps50 at fixed H
classification.horizon_difference: absolute difference between H=80 and H=64 at fixed precision for stationary fields or fixed declared extraction horizon for transport coefficients
classification.algebraic_cross_check: absolute difference between each finest propagation extraction and its constrained stationary or transport-polynomial solve
classification.validated: Every applicable cell error, precision difference, horizon difference, algebraic cross-check, invariant discrepancy, and residual is at or below its preregistered ceiling.
classification.contradicted: All applicable precision and horizon differences and residuals meet their ceilings, but every corresponding isolated-route/reference cell error exceeds 1e-12.
classification.overall: Fail closed: contradicted if any required item is contradicted; otherwise unresolved if any item, mandatory limit check, provenance check, or isolation audit is unresolved or fails; validated only if every required item validates.
classification.scientific_numeric_serialization: Serialize every finite scientific value, reference, discrepancy, refinement difference, residual, condition quantity, and limit discrepancy as a decimal string with 50 significant digits. Binary JSON floating-point numbers, NaN, and infinity are prohibited for scientific quantities.

complete_reset.expected_reference: Accepted T-012 complete-reset stationary solution, independently evaluated for the full 28-state field and every accepted derived second-order scalar at the exact rational case parameters.
complete_reset.estimator_and_uncertainty: all four fixed deterministic precision/horizon cells plus the dps80 constrained stationary solve; stochastic uncertainty is not applicable
complete_reset.discrepancy: absolute componentwise difference from T-012 with threshold 1e-12; fitting-window and time-step discretization envelopes are not applicable
complete_reset.classification: Validated only when every T-012 component and derived-scalar row, refinement, cross-check, invariant, and residual validates. Contradicted when the numerical route is converged but every cell for any T-012 row lies outside 1e-12. Unresolved otherwise.

passive.requirement: At every activity in the locked sequence, all seven maps validate every applicable T-022 field. For each position map, absolute raw_MSD discrepancy from its listed Pe=0 law must decrease strictly to zero. For each transport map, absolute D_eff discrepancy from its listed Pe=0 law must decrease strictly to zero. At Pe=0, orientation-reset pairs must agree in translational outputs and no active-only cancellation may be used.
passive.estimator_and_uncertainty: dps80/H80 deterministic extraction; stochastic uncertainty is not applicable
passive.discrepancy: absolute scalar difference; fitting-window and time-step discretization envelopes are not applicable
passive.classification: Validated only when all underlying formula rows validate, every declared discrepancy decreases strictly along Pe=6/5,3/5,3/10,0, the terminal discrepancies are at most 1e-12, and endpoint pair equalities validate. Contradicted when any converged formula row is contradicted. Unresolved otherwise.

rare_reset.position_protocol_expected_law: 4+2*Pe^2 for P, PV, PTheta, and PVTheta

transport_protocol_expected_laws.b_x: Pe for V, Theta, and VTheta

rare_reset.estimator_and_uncertainty: dps80/H80 deterministic extraction; stochastic uncertainty is not applicable
rare_reset.discrepancy: absolute scalar difference; fitting-window and time-step discretization envelopes are not applicable
rare_reset.acceptance: After the underlying formula rows validate, each listed absolute discrepancy decreases strictly along rho=1,1/2,1/4. An identically exact-zero discrepancy at all three points validates as an exact finite-M identity rather than failing strictness.

frequent_reset.estimator_and_uncertainty: dps80/H80 deterministic extraction; stochastic uncertainty is not applicable
frequent_reset.discrepancy: absolute scalar difference; fitting-window and time-step discretization envelopes are not applicable
frequent_reset.acceptance: After the underlying formula rows validate, each listed absolute discrepancy decreases strictly along rho=1,2,4.

resonance.requirement: Both M=1 and M=2 active cases validate every applicable T-022 field without substituting a removable-singularity formula or changing the extraction rule.
resonance.estimator_and_uncertainty: all four fixed deterministic precision/horizon cells; stochastic uncertainty is not applicable
resonance.discrepancy: absolute field-component difference; fitting-window and time-step discretization envelopes are not applicable

strict_overdamped_trend.position_protocol_expected_law: R_overdamped=2I/rho+2*Pe^2*U/[rho*(rho+1)]; r_bar=0 for P/PV and Pe*e_x/(rho+1) for PTheta/PVTheta; centered covariance is R_overdamped-r_bar*r_bar^T, with U=I/2 without orientation reset and U=diag((rho+2)/(rho+4),2/(rho+4)) with orientation reset.
strict_overdamped_trend.estimator_and_uncertainty: dps80/H80 deterministic extraction; stochastic uncertainty is not applicable
strict_overdamped_trend.discrepancy: absolute scalar difference; fitting-window and time-step discretization envelopes are not applicable
strict_overdamped_trend.acceptance: After finite-M formula rows validate, every nonzero listed discrepancy decreases strictly along M=1/4,1/16,1/64; an identically exact-zero sequence validates as an exact finite-M identity. Velocity-reset maps are disclosed as singular-limit distinctions, not collapsed by direct substitution.
strict_overdamped_trend.claim: Finite-grid numerical support only; it does not replace the contract's singular-limit interpretation.

execution_controls.strict_json_loader: Reject duplicate keys, nonfinite constants, non-object roots, and nonfinite values nested at any depth.
execution_controls.canonical_semantics: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=false, and allow_nan=false.
execution_controls.plan_semantic_lock: The runner hardcodes the SHA-256 of canonical semantics of this exact plan; every field is semantic and mutation fails before execution.
execution_controls.validate_mode: May validate plan syntax, imports, source manifest, isolation, paths, and synthetic fixtures. It must not evaluate the canonical grid or create the canonical artifact.
execution_controls.canonical_output_precondition: The canonical output path must be absent before execution.
execution_controls.one_shot_clean_source_execution: Execute exactly once from a clean committed source tree; record the full commit SHA and atomically create the canonical artifact without overwrite.

stop_rules.bl2: Stop before scientific classification on provenance, plan-lock, import isolation, forbidden artifact access, basis, reset-map construction, nonfinite value, exact-rational parsing, matrix construction, residual, or T-022 comparison-adapter failure.
stop_rules.bl3: A converged isolated-route disagreement is contradicted; do not change maps, grid, extraction, precision, horizons, formulas, or tolerance.
stop_rules.unresolved: Failed refinement, tail/horizon agreement, residual, mandatory limit check, or strict overdamped trend is unresolved.
stop_rules.rerun: Do not rerun, retry, top up, or write an alternate canonical result.
stop_rules.revision: Any change requires a new versioned preregistration before another execution.
